english.note: For personal curiosity or hobbies, 興趣 is the all-purpose choice.

exampleSentences.english: I have a lot of interest in photography.

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for liking or interest, especially in an activity, subject, or thing.

exampleSentences.english: I have a real fancy for hiking.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 haang4 saan1 hou2 jau5 hing3 ceoi3

english.note: Use this for a subject or activity someone is keenly interested in, such as a hobby or personal interest.

exampleSentences.english: I have always had a lot of enthusiasm for photography.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我對攝影一直都好有興趣。
